page_title: ARS 1-0 CRY | Arsenal v Crystal Palace 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Thomas Bramall has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+1' The game has come to an end for Adam Wharton. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).
90+1' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Daniel Munoz and he is replaced by Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace).
90+1' Tyrick Mitchell comes off the pitch to be replaced by Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace).
90+1' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' A dangerous looking corner kick from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is cleared to safety by the defence.
90' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) will take the corner.
89' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
88' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) replacing Eberechi Eze.
85' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
84' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and Thomas Bramall immediately signals a free kick.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikel Merino (Arsenal) is coming onto the pitch as Declan Rice cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Piero Hincapie (Arsenal) coming on for Riccardo Calafiori.
81' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
80' The corner kick picks out Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
80' The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
79' Good clearance! Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
75' The attendance is 60103.
74' Dangerous play by Jurrien Timber (Arsenal). Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Substitution. Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Daichi Kamada walks off.
71' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
70' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
68' Declan Rice (Arsenal) prepares to take a corner kick.

68' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
66' The substitution has been made. Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) has replaced Bukayo Saka.
65' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Bramall interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
64' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

63' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner.
61' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Bramall blows for a foul.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yeremy Pino trots off the pitch and is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
56' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) is penalised for holding. Thomas Bramall signals a set piece.
51' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post.
51' Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
51' Gabriel (Arsenal) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
50' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes a short free kick.
49' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace). Arsenal are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
46' Substitution. Cristhian Mosquera (Arsenal) replaces William Saliba.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle and it's Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Declan Rice (Arsenal) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
43' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Arsenal will take a free kick.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Crystal Palace comes to nothing.
39' 1 - 0 Goal! Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:0.
38' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Thomas Bramall signals.

33' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Dean Henderson guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
32' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
30' Declan Rice (Arsenal) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
29' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal have a free kick.
28' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Bramall saw the whole situation.
27' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
24' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
22' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
21' Wonderful movement by Arsenal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
18' 74:26 – the ratio of ball possession.
13' Flag goes up against Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

10' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) makes a good late run into the box and times his jump perfectly to get on the end of the corner kick, but his close-range header is brilliant blocked to deny him a certain goal.
10' Corner kick. Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is ready to send the ball into the box.
8' The foul by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) was seen by Thomas Bramall who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
7' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
6' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' The match has just started.
Arsenal will kick the game off.
